entry.name: Google AI Essentials
entry.note: A course certificate, not a proctored exam; a non-technical introduction to using generative AI at work
entry.audience: Anyone in a non-technical role who wants working fluency with generative AI

covers: Using generative AI tools to develop ideas and content
Applying prompting techniques including few-shot prompting
Using AI responsibly and identifying potential biases
Recognising the importance of human oversight when using AI
Evaluating AI outputs and privacy and security risks
Staying up to date in the emerging landscape of AI
reading.format: A self-paced program delivered in under 10 hours, with hands-on activities in which learners solve workplace tasks using AI. It is available in 17 languages.
reading.summary: Google AI Essentials is a self-paced program taught by AI experts at Google that helps people across roles and industries build AI skills to boost productivity. It shows learners how to use generative AI tools for everyday work tasks such as generating ideas and content, researching and organising, and drafting email responses. Completing the program earns a certificate from Google that can be shared with a network and potential employers.
reading.audience: It is for people across roles and industries who want AI skills to boost their productivity. No prior experience is required.
reading.prerequisites: Zero experience required. No programming skills are needed.
